# Opslane

> Opslane watches errors and session recordings from a web app, investigates the ones worth fixing against the connected repository, and opens a pull request after its build and tests pass in a sandbox. When it cannot fix something, it records a plain reason and a next step. You run Opslane on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose. The server, worker, agent core, dashboard, and CLI are AGPL-3.0-only; the SDKs and shared types are MIT.

Every page below is published at https://docs.opslane.com. Each link points to its source file in this repository.

## Get started

- [Introduction](docs-site/src/content/docs/index.mdx): what Opslane is and where to start
- [Run Opslane locally](docs/quickstart/self-host.md): Docker Compose stack, a seeded project, and a first event that stops with a clear reason when fix credentials are absent
- [Install the SDK](docs/install.md): React, Vue, and vanilla setup; signed-in user IDs; environment labels; source-map uploads

## How it works

- [How Opslane works](docs/how-it-works.md): the path from a browser error to an issue, a fix pull request, or a clear reason to stop
- [Catching bugs that don't throw](docs/guides/friction.md): dead buttons, blocked forms, session recording analysis, and approval before fixes
- [What "verified" means](docs/architecture/precision.md): the checks behind a ready or draft pull request and what those checks do not guarantee

## Connect your project

- [Connect GitHub](docs/guides/github-app.md): GitHub App or personal access token, permissions, webhook events
- [Upload source maps](docs/guides/source-maps.md): the Vite plugin, `OPSLANE_SOURCEMAP_KEY`, build diagnostics, verification
- [Environments](docs/guides/environments.md): label resolution, the project default, and limiting automatic error investigation by environment
- [Notifications](docs/guides/slack-notifications.md): Slack webhooks, new-issue alerts, and the daily digest

## Privacy and data

- [What leaves your host](docs/architecture/trust.md): what each external service receives, credential storage, retention, and current gaps
- [Replay privacy and masking](docs/guides/replay-privacy.md): capture defaults, masking classes, server-side scrubbing, retention
- [Source-map privacy](docs/guides/source-map-privacy.md): where uploaded source lives and who can read it

## Reference

- [SDK options](docs/reference/sdk-options.md): every `init()` option with type and default
- [HTTP routes](docs/reference/http-routes.md): every registered route with its auth mode
- [Reason codes](docs/reference/reason-codes.md): every reason Opslane can stop and ask for help, with the next step for each one
- [Environment variables](docs/reference/environment-variables.md): every variable each service reads, including known dead config
- [API keys](docs/guides/api-keys.md): `opslane_pk_` ingest keys and `opslane_sk_` source-map keys, minting, rotation, 401 vs 403
